thread:
toni: quick update: rolling out adaptive-quant-batcher (int8-aware batching + dynamic token window) to a 10% canary. short numbers below.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started 2009999997 by toni -> runtime:adaptive-quant-batcher:v1 (10%)

reza: numbers? p50/p95/p99 + cost impact?

toni: 30m canary window: p50 -13%, p95 -9%, p99 -11%. token GPU-cost per request -20%. best gains on mixed short+mid seqs.

pat: any quality/regression checks? int8 worries me for edge cases.

toni: ran nightly eval + targeted truncation tests. semantic sim within +/-0.4%. safety: int8 path gated by model.quant_profile=="safe_int8" and entropy check. fallback to fp16 on high-entropy.

opsbot: NOTICE 2009999990: brief spike in packer latency in eu-central (+22%) for 90s. auto-adjust applied.

toni: saw that. root cause: packer fragmentation from many tiny chunks. mitigation: reduced batcher.min_chunk_tokens  from 32->20 for eu-central and enabled chunk-merge hotfix. bumped canary to 20% after 15m stable.

reza: flags and PR link? need to script alerts.

toni: flags: "serve.adaptive_quant_batcher_enabled", "serve.quant_batch_max_tokens". PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/601. curl to fetch canary summary: 

curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=adaptive_quant_batcher&window=30m" | jq '.summary'

sana: adding auto-rule: runtime.adaptive_quant_batcher.region.p99 > baseline*1.12 -> page oncall and rollback to previous batcher config.

toni: thanks all. plan: 20% -> 50% after 2h stable, full roll after nightly eval pass and ops sign-off. will update on next bump. :rocket:
